title: EVPN RT Mismatch — dc1-leaf1b VNI 10011 wrong export
symptom: EVPN Type-2 routes for VLAN 11 (VNI 10011) on dc1-leaf1b not imported by dc1-leaf2a and dc1-leaf2b
root_cause: RT export for VLAN 11 changed to wrong value Route-Target-AS:10011:99999
fix_command: router bgp 65101 / vlan 11 / route-target export Route-Target-AS:10011:10011
